semiconductor_relevance: High — LSE Co., Ltd. specializes in semiconductor equipment, particularly in wet cleaning processes essential for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: LSE Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of semiconductor equipment in Korea, focusing on wet cleaning processes. Their flagship product, SPACE, is designed for advanced cleaning of single wafers, catering to the needs of sub-30nm device technology.
capabilities: Wet cleaning solutions for semiconductor fabrication

regional_presence.Korea: LSE is the largest representative of electronics components and semiconductor equipment in Korea, emphasizing strong customer support and service.
